task: ae.chain UTXO ledger with Merkle proofs, PoW blocks and reorg
reasoning_summary: UtxoSet applies blocks atomically with an undo log so reorgs undo to the common ancestor and replay the new branch. Side blocks are validated against state replayed from genesis. Tests include Merkle known answers, per-rule rejection tests asserting messages and unchanged state, and seeded fork simulations compared with an independent oracle plus a supply invariant.
